Our Story

The man who built the Hill Country

Before everyone claimed to be a metal building expert, Terry was already doing it. He opened his welding shop in Burnet in 1984 — a time when metal buildings were rare in the Hill Country and Terry was one of the only men who knew how to build them right.

Word spread fast. His first storage buildings at Seward Junction led to more calls than he could count. Decades later, his landmark work includes buildings recognized across the region — from The White Moose and the Donut Shop in Burnet to an exclusive long-running partnership with Tito's Vodka.

Terry has never advertised. He has never needed to. His reputation has done every bit of the talking — and now we're ready to let the rest of Texas know he's still building.

Iron Wolf Ranch & Distillery · Spicewood, TX · Built by T Bucket Welding

Transparent Pricing

Straightforward.
No surprises.

Service Rate Notes
Standard Metal Building $25 per linear foot Building structure only — does not include concrete
Concrete Work $10–$20 per sq ft Scheduled and managed separately by client
Specialty / Complex Projects $125 per man/hour + materials Custom builds, unusual specs, or multi-material projects
Exterior Doors Included Standard exterior door setting included in build
Windows Additional cost Quoted per project
Paint / Finish Coating Not included Client arranges painting through their preferred contractor

All quotes are provided after a detailed conversation about your project. Materials are due upon delivery to the job site. Final payment is due upon completion. Terry will walk you through everything before any work begins.
